axis.description: int, optional Axis along which the cumulative product is computed. By default the input is flattened.

out.description: ndarray, optional Alternative output array in which to place the result. It must have the same shape and buffer length as the expected output but the type of the resulting values will be cast if necessary.

output.description: ------- ndarray A new array holding the result is returned unless `out` is specified, in which case it is returned.
